content: {"praised":["Cute, pleasant, and good-natured comedy with enjoyable humor.","Mark Harmon and Kirstie Alley deliver charming performances.","The film is light, fun, and entertaining.","Good for nostalgic viewers, still enjoyable after 20 years.","Teachers portrayed as inspiring, heartwarming characters."],"criticized":["Boring and hard to watch throughout the film.","Vulgar language and swearing make it unsuitable.","Previews were misleading, leading to disappointment.","Story feels predictable and lacks depth.","Pacing feels slow, causing boredom."]}
